nodes.title: Part 1: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Quick primer on Part 1. Tap to flip cards covering the most-asked exam ideas in this domain.

flashcards.front: An administrator needs to insert a FortiGate into an existing network between two switches without changing IP addressing on any device. The FortiGate should pass all traffic transparently and apply security policies. Which deployment mode achieves this?
flashcards.back: Transparent mode deploys FortiGate as a Layer 2 bridge — no IP addresses needed on physical interfaces. All traffic passes through transparently, making it ideal for inserting security without redesigning the network. Sniffer mode is passive (no blocking). Virtual wire pair is similar but transparent mode is the standard answer for this scenario. passing traffic while inspecting it

flashcards.front: A security analyst notices that a FortiGate security policy is matching traffic but the actions from the attached IPS profile are not taking effect. What is the most likely cause?
flashcards.back: In NGFW mode (policy-based), security profiles like IPS are embedded directly in the policy rather than attached as separate profiles. If an IPS profile was created for profile-based mode, it may not apply correctly in NGFW mode. Profile-based mode uses separate profile attachments; NGFW mode integrates them inline. not via a separate profile attachment

flashcards.front: FortiGuard provides various subscription services. An administrator wants to enable URL category-based web filtering on a FortiGate. Which FortiGuard subscription must be active?
flashcards.back: FortiGuard Web Filtering subscription provides URL categorization — Fortinet maintains a cloud database of hundreds of millions of URLs organized into categories (social media, gambling, malware, etc.). The FortiGate queries this database to classify URLs. Application Control identifies applications by protocol behavior; IPS detects exploits; AV scans file content. which provides URL category ratings from Fortinet's global database

flashcards.front: An administrator must prevent all users on the internal network from accessing social media sites during business hours (08:00–17:00, Mon–Fri) but allow access outside these hours. What combination of FortiGate features achieves this?
flashcards.back: FortiGate web filter profiles support category-based blocking (social media includes Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, etc.). A schedule object defines when the blocking policy is active. The two-policy pattern: (1) Policy with schedule + blocking web filter = blocks during business hours; (2) Policy without schedule + permissive web filter = allows at all times, but only matches after policy 1 expires. Application control (option A) cannot apply time-based schedules as precisely. attach it to a security policy with a recurring schedule object (Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00); a second policy with no schedule allows access outside business hours

pairs.stem: FortiGuard provides various subscription services. An administrator wants to enable URL category-based web filtering on a FortiGate. Which FortiGuard subscription must be active?
pairs.option: FortiGuard Web Filtering subscription,.

pairs.stem: An administrator needs to insert a FortiGate into an existing network between two switches without changing IP addressing on any device. The FortiGate should pass all traffic transparently and apply security policies. Which deployment mode achieves this?
pairs.option: Transparent mode — FortiGate operates as a Layer 2 bridge with no IP on physical interfaces.

pairs.stem: A security analyst notices that a FortiGate security policy is matching traffic but the actions from the attached IPS profile are not taking effect. What is the most likely cause?
pairs.option: The policy's inspection mode is set to flow-based, which does not support IPS profiles

pairs.stem: A FortiGate has two WAN interfaces: WAN1 (100 Mbps, primary ISP) and WAN2 (50 Mbps, backup ISP). The administrator wants traffic to use WAN1 unless it goes down, then automatically fail over to WAN2. What FortiGate feature achieves this?
pairs.option: Enable ECMP (Equal Cost Multi-Path) routing with both WAN interfaces at equal metric, distributing load across both ISPs

pairs.stem: An administrator must prevent all users on the internal network from accessing social media sites during business hours (08:00–17:00, Mon–Fri) but allow access outside these hours. What combination of FortiGate features achieves this?
pairs.option: Create an application control profile blocking social media categories and attach it to a permanent security policy

pairs.stem: A FortiGate is configured with multiple security policies. Traffic from the LAN is being denied despite a policy that should allow it. What is the most likely reason?
pairs.option: The FortiGate evaluates security policies top-to-bottom and uses the first matching policy;.

nodes.title: Part 2: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Quick primer on Part 2. Tap to flip cards covering the most-asked exam ideas in this domain.

flashcards.front: A FortiGate administrator needs to enable remote management access via HTTPS only on the WAN interface for a specific administrator's IP address (198.51.100.5). What two configurations are required?
flashcards.back: Two steps: (1) Enable HTTPS administrative access on the WAN interface under System > Network > Interfaces. (2) Restrict access by either setting trusted hosts on the admin account (which limits which IPs that admin can log in from) or using a local-in policy. Trusted hosts on the admin account (option C) also achieves this — both approaches are valid but option A is more granular.

flashcards.front: A user reports they cannot access a specific website. The FortiGate web filter log shows the site is blocked under the 'Unrated' category. The administrator verifies the site is legitimate. What is the quickest solution?
flashcards.back: The quickest operational solution is to add the site's URL to a web filter URL override (allow list) in the web filter profile. URL overrides take precedence over category-based rules. The override can be applied immediately. Submitting for re-categorization (option B) is correct long-term but may take days. Disabling Unrated (option C) is a security risk.

flashcards.front: An administrator needs to configure a site-to-site IPsec VPN between a FortiGate (HQ) and a branch office FortiGate. Both have static public IPs. The tunnel must use IKEv2 with pre-shared key authentication. Which Phase 1 settings are mandatory?
flashcards.back: IPsec Phase 1 (IKE SA) negotiates the secure channel for key exchange. Mandatory settings: remote peer IP (or hostname), authentication method (PSK or certificate — PSK means pre-shared key), IKE version (2 for IKEv2), and encryption/authentication proposals. Phase 1 does NOT include Phase 2 selectors — those are defined in Phase 2 (IPsec SA). Certificates are an alternative to PSK, not required for IKEv2. Phase 1 negotiates the IKE SA (encryption and authentication algorithms)

flashcards.front: Remote workers need to access internal company resources using FortiGate SSL VPN. After connecting via the web portal, users can only access the resources listed in the portal bookmarks, not arbitrary internal IPs. What must be configured to allow full network access?
flashcards.back: SSL VPN operates in two modes: Web Mode (browser-based portal with bookmarks to specific applications only) and Tunnel Mode (FortiClient creates a virtual NIC, obtains a tunnel IP from a pool, and routes all or split traffic through the VPN). To access arbitrary internal IP addresses, Tunnel Mode must be enabled in the SSL VPN portal configuration. Users need FortiClient installed to use tunnel mode.

pairs.stem: A FortiGate administrator needs to collect and correlate logs from multiple FortiGate devices across several branch offices into a single management console for analysis and reporting. Which Fortinet product is designed for this purpose?
pairs.option: FortiAnalyzer, which collects logs.

pairs.stem: Remote workers need to access internal company resources using FortiGate SSL VPN. After connecting via the web portal, users can only access the resources listed in the portal bookmarks, not arbitrary internal IPs. What must be configured to allow full network access?
pairs.option: Configure the SSL VPN portal as a full-access tunnel portal with the 'Tunnel Mode' option enabled, and assign users an IP from a tunnel IP pool so the client gets a virtual adapter with LAN access

pairs.stem: An administrator needs to configure a site-to-site IPsec VPN between a FortiGate (HQ) and a branch office FortiGate. Both have static public IPs. The tunnel must use IKEv2 with pre-shared key authentication. Which Phase 1 settings are mandatory?
pairs.option: Remote gateway IP, digital certificate, and Diffie-Hellman group; certificates are required for IKEv2

pairs.stem: A FortiGate administrator needs to verify whether a specific IP address matches any firewall policy and which policy it would match. Which diagnostic tool is most effective for this?
pairs.option: Use the policy lookup tool in the FortiGate GUI: Policy & Objects > Policy Lookup.

pairs.stem: A user reports they cannot access a specific website. The FortiGate web filter log shows the site is blocked under the 'Unrated' category. The administrator verifies the site is legitimate. What is the quickest solution?
pairs.option: Submit the site to FortiGuard for re-categorization and wait for the rating database to update

pairs.stem: A FortiGate administrator needs to enable remote management access via HTTPS only on the WAN interface for a specific administrator's IP address (198.51.100.5). What two configurations are required?
pairs.option: Enable HTTPS on the WAN interface and configure an address object for 198.51.100.5 in the admin profile

nodes.title: Part 3: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Quick primer on Part 3. Tap to flip cards covering the most-asked exam ideas in this domain.

flashcards.front: A FortiGate is receiving IPsec VPN connections from remote FortiClients but some clients with dynamic IP addresses cannot establish the VPN. The Phase 1 is configured with the remote gateway set to a static IP. What change resolves this?
flashcards.back: For remote access VPN (FortiClient connecting to FortiGate), configure the Phase 1 remote gateway type as 'Dialup User'. This tells the FortiGate to accept IKE connections from any source IP. The FortiGate becomes the VPN server and clients can connect from any IP. Aggressive mode with dial-up is the standard FortiGate remote access VPN pattern.

flashcards.front: An administrator has configured SSL VPN with FortiToken two-factor authentication (2FA). Users report that after entering their username, password, and token code, they receive an authentication failure. RADIUS logs show a successful authentication. What is the most likely cause?
flashcards.back: In FortiGate SSL VPN with 2FA, authentication happens in stages. If RADIUS accepts the credentials but FortiGate shows failure, check: (1) The FortiToken serial number is correctly registered to the user account in FortiGate, (2) FortiGate NTP is synchronized (FortiToken TOTP is time-based — drift causes mismatch), (3) The user is in an LDAP/RADIUS group that's mapped to the correct SSL VPN portal. Time drift is the most common cause of OTP validation failures after initial setup.

flashcards.front: A security administrator wants FortiGate to generate an alert and block traffic when it detects a port scan originating from an internal host. Which security feature should be enabled?
flashcards.back: DoS Protection policies on FortiGate include port scan detection (TCP/UDP port sweep and scan threshold settings). Configure a DoS policy on the internal interface to detect scan-type traffic. IPS can also detect scan patterns (option B), but DoS policies are specifically designed for network-level anomaly detection like port scans and flood protection.

flashcards.front: A FortiGate has two virtual domains (VDOMs): VDOM_A for sales and VDOM_B for engineering. The administrator needs both VDOMs to share internet access through a single WAN link. Which configuration enables this?
flashcards.back: Inter-VDOM links (virtual interfaces connecting VDOMs internally) allow traffic to flow between VDOMs. Configure inter-VDOM links from VDOM_A → Root and VDOM_B → Root (or an 'internet' VDOM containing the WAN interface). Each VDOM has a default route via its inter-VDOM link. The internet VDOM routes traffic out the WAN and applies SNAT. This is the standard multi-VDOM internet sharing architecture. VDOM_B, and the root/internet VDOM so both VDOMs route internet-bound traffic to the VDOM containing the WAN interface

pairs.stem: A FortiGate administrator wants to configure web filtering to allow access to the 'Video Streaming' category only for the marketing department users, while blocking it for all other users. What is the correct approach?
pairs.option: Create two security policies: one for marketing users (linked via FSSO group) with a permissive web filter profile.

pairs.stem: FortiGate has an IPsec VPN tunnel that has been working correctly. Users report they can no longer access resources across the tunnel. What is the first CLI diagnostic command the administrator should run to verify the tunnel status?
pairs.option: diagnose debug application ike -1 — enables verbose IKE debugging to trace tunnel negotiation in real time

pairs.stem: An administrator wants to implement network segmentation by creating multiple isolated networks on FortiGate. Each network segment should have its own policies and not share routing tables with others. Which FortiGate feature provides this logical separation?
pairs.option: Configure security zones with separate address objects and apply inter-zone policies to control traffic

pairs.stem: An administrator has configured a FortiGate policy with source address 'all' and destination address 'all' for internet access, with NAT enabled. A security audit flags this as overly permissive. Which addresses should replace 'all' for the source?
pairs.option: Replace with a subnet address object matching the specific LAN interface subnet only.

pairs.stem: A FortiGate is receiving IPsec VPN connections from remote FortiClients but some clients with dynamic IP addresses cannot establish the VPN. The Phase 1 is configured with the remote gateway set to a static IP. What change resolves this?
pairs.option: Change the remote gateway type in Phase 1 from 'Static IP Address' to 'Dialup User' to accept connections from any source IP

pairs.stem: A FortiGate web filter profile is configured to redirect blocked websites to a FortiGate-hosted 'Access Denied' page. Users report the block page is not appearing — instead they see a browser connection error. What is the most likely cause?
pairs.option: The block page only displays when the security policy uses proxy-based inspection mode; flow-based mode cannot deliver block pages

nodes.title: Part 4: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Quick primer on Part 4. Tap to flip cards covering the most-asked exam ideas in this domain.

flashcards.front: An administrator is configuring explicit web proxy on FortiGate for users who have their browsers set to use a proxy server. Which FortiGate configuration is needed to enable explicit proxy?
flashcards.back: Explicit web proxy: FortiGate listens on a specified port (default 8080) on a specific interface. Browsers are manually configured (or via PAC file/WPAD) to send all HTTP/HTTPS traffic to FortiGate:8080. FortiGate then forwards requests on behalf of the client. Configuration: System > Feature Visibility (enable Explicit Proxy), then configure the proxy settings per-interface. configure the proxy listening port (default 8080), and create explicit proxy policies to control access

flashcards.front: A FortiGate administrator wants to use FortiGate as a DNS server for the internal network and apply DNS filtering to block malicious domains. What configuration is required?
flashcards.back: FortiGate DNS filtering: enable DNS service on the internal interface (acts as a DNS resolver for clients). Apply a DNS filter profile to the DNS security policy — the profile uses FortiGuard DNS rating to block queries for malicious, phishing, or botnet domains. Point client DNS settings to the FortiGate interface IP. The FortiGate responds to queries and applies filtering before forwarding to upstream DNS. enable DNS service) with a DNS filter profile applied to the DNS policy, then point clients to the FortiGate IP as their DNS server

flashcards.front: A FortiGate displays a warning: 'conserve mode'. CPU and memory usage are within normal ranges. What is the most likely cause and what action should be taken?
flashcards.back: FortiGate conserve mode activates when system memory drops below a critical threshold (varies by model). In conserve mode, FortiGate drops new sessions and disables memory-intensive features to protect existing connections and prevent a crash. Investigate: run 'diagnose hardware sysinfo memory' and 'diagnose sys top' to identify what process is consuming memory. Common causes: large flow tables, content inspection buffers, or botnet correlation. investigate what is consuming memory (connection table, content inspection buffers, etc.)

flashcards.front: An administrator must configure FortiGate to protect a web application from OWASP Top 10 attacks including SQL injection, XSS, and CSRF. Which FortiGate security profile provides web application-level protection?
flashcards.back: FortiGate includes a Web Application Firewall (WAF) profile specifically designed to protect web applications from OWASP Top 10 attacks. WAF profiles contain signatures for SQLi, XSS, CSRF, command injection, path traversal, and more. The WAF profile is applied to security policies protecting inbound traffic to web servers. IPS can detect some web attacks but WAF provides comprehensive OWASP coverage. XSS, and CSRF protection signatures, and attached to the security policy handling traffic to the web server

pairs.stem: An administrator configures email alerts on FortiGate for critical security events. After configuration, no emails are being received despite security events occurring. What should be verified first?
pairs.option: Verify the FortiGate can reach the SMTP relay server: check routing.

pairs.stem: An administrator is configuring explicit web proxy on FortiGate for users who have their browsers set to use a proxy server. Which FortiGate configuration is needed to enable explicit proxy?
pairs.option: Enable the explicit web proxy feature on the FortiGate interface where clients connect.

pairs.stem: An administrator needs to verify that a specific user (jsmith@company.com) was authenticated via FSSO and identify which FortiGate security policy is being applied to their traffic. Which CLI command provides this information?
pairs.option: get user fsso list — lists FSSO-connected users and their current session details

pairs.stem: An administrator must configure FortiGate to protect a web application from OWASP Top 10 attacks including SQL injection, XSS, and CSRF. Which FortiGate security profile provides web application-level protection?
pairs.option: Application Control profile with the 'Web Application' category set to monitor mode

pairs.stem: A FortiGate administrator wants to use FortiGate as a DNS server for the internal network and apply DNS filtering to block malicious domains. What configuration is required?
pairs.option: Configure FortiGate as a DNS server (System > DNS.

pairs.stem: A FortiGate security policy has 'log all sessions' enabled. The administrator notices the log storage fills up quickly. They only need to log denied traffic and allowed traffic to specific sensitive servers. What is the best configuration change?
pairs.option: Disable all logging and use SNMP traps to capture critical security events instead
